Definition: Jishvi, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ishui or Ishuai or Isui or Jesui = "he resembles me"; 1) the 2nd son of Saul by his wife Ahinoam; 2) the 3rd son of Asher and founder of the family of Ishuaites
